“The number of those called to service in the last days, 144,000, is instructive. As noted, they are high priests called as missionaries in the last days. The message, however, is not in the quantity, for again the number need not be taken literally, but in the quality. Twelve represents priesthood. Multiplying the number by itself adds wholeness (as would multiplying it by seven). Thus, the number denotes the quality of priesthood held by those who are God’s servants in the last days” (Richard D. Draper, “Understanding Images and Symbols in the Book of Revelation,” inShedding Light on the New Testament: Acts–Revelation, ed. Ray L. Huntington and others [2009], 275–76).
